title: Structural Parameterizations for Eternal Vertex Cover
summary: Eternal Vertex Cover (EVC) is a turn-based attacker-defender game on an undirected graph $G$. To begin with, the defender places $k$ guards on vertices of $G$. The attacker, on their turn, can choose an edge $e$ not already occupied at both endpoints to "attack". The edge $e$ is defended if a guard moves along the edge $e$. The defender, on their turn, can move any subset of guards. A guard can only move to a neighboring vertex.
